programmes.t: Rescued Chimpanzees of the Congo With Jane Goodall
programmes.d: Dr. Rebeca Atencia releases the first two chimps to their new semi-wild existence on the sanctuary's new islands, then sets out to rescue an illegally kept pet mandrill, but encounters resistance from angry villagers.

programmes.t: Rescued Chimpanzees of the Congo With Jane Goodall
programmes.d: Rebeca returns from a rescue mission in Angola with eight chimpanzees; scientists study the survival skills of the group, which they release into the wild; researchers also develop a mandrill reintroduction program.
